assets.name: map
assets.prompt: Top-down tactical strategy RPG battlefield map painting for a website backdrop, seen from directly above: green meadows, a winding river with a small stone bridge, patches of dense forest, dirt roads, a small walled stone fort, ruined walls and low cliffs, painterly hand-painted style of a fantasy tactics game map, colour graded towards deep navy blue and teal with muted desaturated tones, dark and low contrast so a grid and interface on top stay readable, even soft lighting, no grid lines, no characters, no units, no creatures, no text, no icons.

assets.name: ring
assets.prompt: A single ornate golden fantasy ring seen at a three-quarter angle, polished gold band with fine engraved filigree, set with a large faceted oval gem whose left half glows sapphire blue and right half glows ruby red, small sparkle highlights on the metal, glossy video game item render, centered, isolated on a fully transparent background, no text, no hands, no characters.

assets.name: corner
assets.prompt: Single corner piece of a sleek angular fantasy video game menu panel frame, placed in the top-left corner of the canvas: a chamfered 45-degree cut corner made of polished gold metal trim with a thin inner line of glowing sapphire blue light, a small faceted diamond gem set at the cut corner, two long thin gold lines run along the top edge and down the left edge and fade out, glossy and crisp, the rest of the canvas empty, isolated on a fully transparent background, no text, no characters.
